summary: Whether the result comes back as a temporary URL or inline base64.
combines: Supported on: `dall-e-2` and `dall-e-3` only. NOT supported on any GPT image model, which always returns base64.
URLs expire 60 minutes after generation, so they must be downloaded and re-hosted.
Sending it with a GPT image model is an error; a codebase that switched from DALL-E must drop the field.
note: GPT Image models return base64 image data; the legacy response_format selector is unsupported.
